title: Establish obligation registry authority backed by a real source census
acceptance_criteria:
• Canonical facet requirements and implications cannot be mutated after import, proven by mutation-attempt tests.
• known-missing-source-clause evidence is representable in a valid registry.
• Multi-part authoritative evidence is captured completely or rejected; partial capture is impossible.
• Synthetic scalar identities cannot collide with projected atom identities.
• The registry authority is grounded in a real source census rather than caller assertion.
